summary: Practise SDS-based compatibility checks, storage mapping, and inspection planning. Explore this five-day chemical storage training course.
lede: Chemical storage training covers using hazard labels and Safety Data Sheets to make safer storage and location decisions. It is intended for chemical storekeepers, laboratory supervisors, EHS specialists and inventory coordinators who manage or review chemical stocks. Participants practise screening incompatibilities, building a compatibility matrix, mapping storage zones, and preparing inventory and inspection records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, review, or support chemical storage decisions. It suits people with some experience handling chemical inventories or workplace safety procedures.
modules: GHS Labels and SDS Storage Data
prerequisites: Working knowledge of chemical handling or workplace safety procedures is expected. Familiarity with reading Safety Data Sheets is useful. No coding or specialist software is required.
